codeImprovements.title: Batch Import & Multi-Format Prompt Importer (YAML/CSV)
codeImprovements.description: Extend the Prompt Library JSON importer to natively parse YAML and CSV formats with automatic tag categorization.
codeImprovements.rationale: The code in PromptStorage and PromptService already handles JSON validation and merge strategies. Adding a parser abstraction allows developers to import external team prompts effortlessly.
codeImprovements.implementation_approach: Create a FormatParser strategy pattern that detects YAML/CSV headers, transforms records to PromptItem, and calls existing importPrompts().

codeImprovements.title: Autonomous Feature Execution Loop via MCP Bridge
codeImprovements.description: Provide an autonomous agent orchestration loop that takes a roadmap feature, creates a branch, runs tests, and updates status to completed.
codeImprovements.rationale: RoadmapModule already exposes granular MCP tools for querying and updating feature statuses. Connecting this to git commands and test runners establishes a self-driving developer loop.
codeImprovements.implementation_approach: Expose a roadmap_execute_feature tool that packages the user story & acceptance criteria into an agent subtask with automated verification.

codeImprovements.title: Multi-Format Roadmap Exporter (Linear/Jira CSV & JSON-LD)
codeImprovements.description: Extend the ROADMAP.md generator to export formatted issue CSVs ready for 1-click import into Linear, Jira, or GitHub Projects.
codeImprovements.rationale: The RoadmapGenerator already maintains structured MoSCoW priorities, acceptance criteria, and user stories. Adding a CSV/JSON-LD serializer enables instant team workflow integration.
codeImprovements.implementation_approach: Add exportToCSV() and exportToLinear() methods on RoadmapGenerator mapping Phase -> Milestone and Feature -> Issue.

codeImprovements.title: Sidecar Live WebSocket State Synchronization
codeImprovements.description: Upgrade the sidecar HTTP polling mechanism to a lightweight bi-directional WebSocket connection for instant UI updates when MCP tools run.
codeImprovements.rationale: The web server (src/web/server.ts) currently serves HTTP REST endpoints. Adding a WebSocket handler eliminates client-side polling and reflects agent tool calls in real-time.
codeImprovements.implementation_approach: Attach a WebSocket listener to the HTTP server instance and broadcast "roadmap:updated" and "prompt:pasted" events to connected sidecar panes.

performanceOptimizations.title: Migrate Synchronous Disk I/O to Non-Blocking Async File Streams
performanceOptimizations.description: Replace blocking fs.readFileSync and fs.writeFileSync in active request paths with non-blocking fs.promises or stream pipelines.
performanceOptimizations.rationale: Synchronous I/O blocks the single-threaded Node.js event loop, preventing concurrent MCP tool requests or sidecar UI interactions.
performanceOptimizations.currentMetric: Synchronous fs calls execute on the main event thread
performanceOptimizations.expectedImprovement: Eliminates event loop delays, providing < 5ms response times under concurrent agent requests
performanceOptimizations.implementation: Convert fs.readFileSync to await fs.promises.readFile and adopt atomic temp-file rename patterns for writes.
performanceOptimizations.tradeoffs: Requires updating callers to handle promises asynchronously (which most already do).

performanceOptimizations.title: Implement In-Memory Read-Through Cache for Prompts & Roadmaps
performanceOptimizations.description: Add an in-memory cache layer with mtime invalidation to avoid hitting the filesystem on every read request.
performanceOptimizations.rationale: Both PromptService and RoadmapStorage frequently read JSON documents from disk on every search, filter, or API call.
performanceOptimizations.currentMetric: Every API request parses JSON from disk from scratch
performanceOptimizations.expectedImprovement: Reduces prompt_search and roadmap_get latency from ~8ms to < 0.2ms (40x throughput boost)
performanceOptimizations.implementation: Keep cached JavaScript object in memory and check fs.statSync mtime before re-reading.

performanceOptimizations.title: Add ETag and Gzip Compression to Local Web Server
performanceOptimizations.description: Serve CSS, JavaScript, and HTML assets with ETag headers and gzip compression for instant sidecar panel reloads.
performanceOptimizations.rationale: When the Antigravity sidecar pane is opened or toggled, it re-fetches static assets from localhost without caching.
performanceOptimizations.currentMetric: Static files served uncompressed without HTTP cache headers
performanceOptimizations.expectedImprovement: Near-instantaneous sidecar load time (304 Not Modified)
performanceOptimizations.implementation: Add simple zlib gzip stream compression and If-None-Match ETag validation for assets in src/web/public/.
performanceOptimizations.tradeoffs: Minimal CPU cost on initial compression.

securityVulnerabilities.title: Harden Workspace Path Resolution Against Directory Traversal
securityVulnerabilities.description: Workspace paths received via MCP arguments and HTTP endpoints should be strictly validated against the project root.
securityVulnerabilities.rationale: If an untrusted tool call provides a relative path like "../../../etc/passwd", unchecked path.resolve could access files outside the workspace.
securityVulnerabilities.vulnerability: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)
securityVulnerabilities.currentRisk: Potential read/write access to files outside designated workspace root if manipulated by malicious prompt injection.
securityVulnerabilities.remediation: Implement a sanitizeWorkspacePath(target, root) helper that verifies targetPath.startsWith(allowedRoot).

securityVulnerabilities.title: Restrict Permissive CORS Wildcard on Local REST Bridge
securityVulnerabilities.description: The local HTTP dashboard sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on API routes. Restrict it to localhost origins or sidecar tokens.
securityVulnerabilities.rationale: A malicious website visited in the user browser could theoretically make fetch() requests to http://localhost:PORT/api/prompts.
securityVulnerabilities.vulnerability: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-Domain Policy with Wildcard (*)
securityVulnerabilities.currentRisk: Cross-origin browser requests could read or manipulate local prompt and roadmap data.
securityVulnerabilities.remediation: Validate the Origin request header to match 127.0.0.1, localhost, or require ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_UI_TOKEN.

securityVulnerabilities.title: Enforce Secret & Token Redaction in Prompt Storage
securityVulnerabilities.description: Add an automated secret detection scanner before saving prompts or roadmaps to prevent accidental leakage of API keys.
securityVulnerabilities.rationale: Developers frequently copy prompts containing temporary API keys or tokens. Auto-redaction ensures secrets are never saved to plain text files.
securityVulnerabilities.vulnerability: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials / Sensitive Data Exposure
securityVulnerabilities.currentRisk: Accidental check-in of API keys or credentials in exported prompt library files.
securityVulnerabilities.remediation: Run regex-based secret detection (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS keys) on prompt templates before saving and offer auto-redaction.

codeQualityIssues.title: Split Monolithic Web UI Client Script into Dedicated Tab Modules
codeQualityIssues.description: The file src/web/public/app.js is growing large (>500 lines) and manages both Prompts, Roadmap, and Ideation tabs in a single script.
codeQualityIssues.rationale: Large multi-responsibility frontend scripts increase cognitive load and risk regressions when editing unrelated view behaviors.
codeQualityIssues.currentState: Single script handling DOM state, API requests, modals, and rendering for all tabs
codeQualityIssues.proposedChange: Extract into modular ES modules: prompts-view.js, roadmap-view.js, ideation-view.js with a lightweight app-shell.js coordinator.

codeQualityIssues.title: Add Automated End-to-End Sidecar UI Token & Port Interop Tests
codeQualityIssues.description: Add automated tests verifying that the sidecar correctly responds to ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT and UI token handshake.
codeQualityIssues.rationale: Sidecar reliability is mission-critical for the plugin appearing in Antigravity Aux Pane without runtime crashes.
codeQualityIssues.currentState: Unit tests cover services and storage, but sidecar token handshake is verified manually
codeQualityIssues.proposedChange: Create src/tests/sidecar.test.ts testing HTTP token authorization and 401 unauthorized rejection.

codeQualityIssues.title: Implement Custom Error Hierarchy with Typed MCP Error Codes
codeQualityIssues.description: Replace generic new Error() throws with domain-specific classes (e.g. WorkspaceNotFoundError, InvalidFeatureIdError).
codeQualityIssues.rationale: Typed errors allow the MCP server to return standardized JSON-RPC error codes (-32602 Invalid params, -32603 Internal error).
codeQualityIssues.currentState: Functions throw generic Error instances with string messages
codeQualityIssues.proposedChange: Create src/errors.ts with PluginError, ValidationError, and StorageError classes.
codeQualityIssues.bestPractice: Typed exceptions and standardized JSON-RPC protocol error mapping
